properties.description:
At 507 PM MDT, emergency management reported thunderstorms producing
heavy rain over the Middle Aspen Acres Burn Scar. Between 0.7 and 1.5
inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.1 to 0.5
inches are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is already
occurring. Excessive rainfall over the burn scar will result in
debris flow moving through the North Saint Charles, South Creek,
Squirrel Creek, Middle Creek, and North Creek Drainages. The debris
flow can consist of rock, mud, vegetation and other loose materials.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Middle Aspen Acres Burn
Scar.

SOURCE...Emergency management reported 6-12 inches of water and
debris flowing down north creek and north creek cutoff at
501 pm.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Middle Aspen Acres Burn Scar.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Beulah.

This includes the following high risk locations...
Beulah Water Intake, Northcreek Road county line to Red Mountain Camp
and Northcreek Road from Red Mountain Camp to Beulah.
properties.instruction:
This is a life-threatening situation for in and around the middle
Aspen Acres Burn Scar. Move away and to higher ground immediately.
